summaries.Romania: Romania faces extreme heat with code orange/yellow weather alerts across multiple regions, while political tensions escalate over constitutional court decisions affecting local governance. Key infrastructure challenges emerge including water scarcity affecting nuclear power operations and drone incidents near offshore gas platforms.
summaries.Healthcare: Personalized cancer vaccines show promising results from Merck and Moderna, while healthcare costs continue rising with employers bracing for 9.5% increases in 2027. AI integration in clinical workflows accelerates as Epic and other platforms embed automation into patient care systems.
summaries.Tech: Apple cuts 200+ jobs across Vision Pro and Siri teams as it refocuses strategy, while major retailers like Walmart finally adopt Apple Pay after years of resistance. AI startups continue raising massive funding rounds as the sector consolidates around foundational models and enterprise applications.

items.title: Cum funcționează vaccinul personalizat care ar putea redefini tratamentul cancerului
items.snippet: Succesul companiilor Merck și Moderna cu un vaccin personalizat împotriva cancerului, conceput pentru a ține melanomul sub control, deschide o nouă cale de tratament despre care medicii speră că va funcționa împotriva multor tipuri de tumori, conform CNN. items.line: Personalized cancer vaccines from Merck and Moderna could redefine tumor treatment by training immune systems rather than destroying healthy cells like chemotherapy.

items.title: Apple lays off 200+ people across Vision Pro and Siri teams
items.snippet: Apple is cutting jobs across multiple teams, according to a new Bloomberg report. All told, the company has cut more than 200 jobs across teams working on Vision Pro, Siri, and software engineering.
items.line: Apple cuts 200+ jobs across Vision Pro and Siri teams, signaling a major strategic retreat from spatial computing and voice AI to focus on undisclosed 'new devices.'

items.title: O fetiță de 4 ani a murit de difterie în Italia. Motivul pentru care părinții au refuzat să o vaccineze
items.snippet: O fetiță de 4 ani a murit de difterie în Palermo, Italia, după ce părinții au refuzat să o vaccineze.  Acum, cazul a stârnit o imensă dezbatere în peninsulă.
items.line: A 4-year-old's death from diphtheria in Italy due to parental vaccine refusal reignites debate over vaccination mandates and medical autonomy across Europe.

items.title: Employers brace for another year of healthcare cost increases
items.snippet: Employers' healthcare costs are set to climb yet again in 2027, with analysts at Aon projecting an increase of 9.5%.
items.line: Employers face another year of escalating healthcare costs with Aon projecting 9.5% increases in 2027, driven largely by chronic disease management and specialty drugs.

items.title: Epic expands AI ambitions with agent platform, Cosmos-powered predictions and workflow automation
items.snippet: As healthcare organizations rapidly adopt artificial intelligence technologies, electronic health record giant Epic aims to be the foundational layer, embedding AI and automation into clinical, operational and administrative workflows.
items.line: Epic's new AI agent platform embeds automation directly into clinical, operational and administrative workflows, positioning the EHR giant as healthcare's foundational AI layer.

items.title: How AI accounting startup Rillet raised $100M and became a unicorn in 48 hours
items.snippet: Rillet CEO Nicolas Kopp shared growth numbers at a board meeting and set off a fundraising frenzy from Iconiq, Sequoia and others. Without even trying.
items.line: AI accounting startup Rillet became a unicorn in 48 hours after its CEO casually shared growth numbers at a board meeting, triggering a funding frenzy from top-tier VCs.

items.title: Walmart to Begin Accepting Apple Pay in U.S. Stores
items.snippet: After years of holding out, Walmart today announced that it will finally begin accepting tap-to-pay options like Apple Pay in some of its Walmart and Sam's Club stores in the U.S. starting Monday, August 24. items.line: Walmart finally rolls out Apple Pay and Google Pay support across stores by end of 2026, ending its decade-long resistance to tap-to-pay compatibility.
